checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square images, not a collage
Bottle matches original silhouette, proportions, lid, matte finish
must.why: The shape is close, but the base gets ribbed texture the original lacks. The forest image changes the lid to a plain loop handle. The white image looks glossier.

must.item: White-background image shows entire bottle with wooden table removed
must.why: The whole bottle sits on clean white and the table is gone.

must.item: Lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench
must.why: The lifestyle scenes are a kitchen counter and a forest rock. There is no gym bench.

must.item: Close-up clearly shows lid and matte surface without inventing features
must.why: No close-up was made. All three images show the full bottle.

faults.what: The forest image changes the lid to a solid loop handle, so the product differs from the original.
The base gets ribbed texture in the white and kitchen images, a feature the original lacks.
The white-background bottle looks glossier and more like a 3D render.
There is no gym-bench scene and no close-up shot.

summary: The output is three clean, text-free square images (white studio, kitchen, forest), but the forest image changes the lid, the base gains invented ribbing, and there is no gym-bench scene or close-up.
